qt: to the Commission Cynthia Ní Mhurchú (Renew) Subject:

Reliable broadband and mobile coverage are increasingly necessary for employment, education, access to healthcare and the operation of small businesses. Gaps in connectivity can deepen the disadvantages faced by rural communities. 1.
What EU funding and regulatory measures can support the extension of reliable highspeed broadband and mobile connectivity to underserved communities in Ireland?
How will the Commission monitor progress towards EU connectivity targets and ensure that rural areas, including remote coastal communities, are not left behind in the digital transition?
